falseSynonyms.zh: 拒絕不等於本課的 decline decline 作動詞可表示禮貌拒絕，但本課處理的是『下降／衰退』名詞與相關意義。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON To decline an invitation means refuse; a decline in sales means a fall.

falseSynonyms.zh: 失敗不等於 decline failure 是沒有成功；decline 是程度、數量或狀況下降，下降未必等於失敗。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A decline can occur without total failure.

falseSynonyms.zh: 損失不等於所有 decline loss 指失去的量或事物；decline 指向下變化的過程／趨勢。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Loss is what is lost; decline is the downward movement.

falseSynonyms.zh: 經濟衰退不等於所有 decline recession 是較特定的宏觀經濟概念；decline 可以出現在任何數量、品質或領域。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A recession is a specific economic condition; decline is much broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 崩跌不等於一般 decline collapse 表示極劇烈、近乎崩潰的下降；普通 decline 可能很輕微。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Collapse is much more severe than an ordinary decline.

falseSynonyms.zh: 波動不等於 decline fluctuation 可上可下；decline 明確是向下。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Fluctuation has no fixed direction; decline does.

falseSynonyms.zh: 停滯不等於 decline stagnation 是幾乎沒有增長或變化；decline 是實際向下。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Stagnation is flat or weak growth; decline moves downward.

falseSynonyms.zh: downturn 只適合某些領域 downturn 很適合經濟、市場、業務低迷，但不適合所有如溫度、人口或品質下降。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Downturn is domain-specific; decline is more general.
